name: Hyuuga
source:
"Fool. Did you really think you could get away?"

An inscrutable young man Yuuki encounters in the financial district. He often works with Yukinami, and is always at his beck and call.

Though he has a caring personality, he's harbored a strong hatred for humanity ever since a certain incident.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
